live.source: FUCompanion.api.experimental.sim.run, pace=batch, guests=false, ZP 0, FP 3, no feathers
live.note: All three logged 'conflict event: none' — sim.run does not read the scene's own conflictEvent flag, so these are storm-free.

liveWithStorm.note: The storm damages BOTH sides, so it barely moves the outcome — but it did KO Zarg in one run. Round count unchanged.

supersededBy.why: Blanche now fights. Her Twin Shields is an exposedVirtualAttack AE with damageBonus "5 + SL_DEFENSIVE_MASTERY"; the loader could read neither, so she contributed ZERO damage to every run captured before this date. Both are now modelled, so every earlier Mindscape figure was pessimistic by roughly one PC.

modelHistory.what: Attribute dice read from <attr>_current (capped d12), not <attr>_base — as the live snapshot rolls them.
modelHistory.note: No change: Keren's DEX went d8 -> d12 (Swimsuit, Swift Swimmers Wet) but none of her modelled actions roll DEX.

modelHistory.what: A weapon swing now counts the weapon's own accuracy bonus (weapon1_mod), which the live snapshot reads.
modelHistory.note: Zarg's bow +1: his damage 88.5 -> 95.7 per round. Moves toward live (2 rounds / 82%); the stated bias still holds, now about -24 points of party HP. Superseded as the baseline by the next entry.

modelHistory.what: A PC's skills granted by UNEQUIPPED gear are gated off (live skill-picker equip gate + skill-effects containerReactionInPlay), Versatile excepted. NPCs are not gated.
modelHistory.note: Hina had been casting spells from gear she was not holding: Glacies Finis x2 (Arch Ice Wand), Starfall + Starfall Comet (Lunar Bow), Encyclopedia Strike. Her damage 45.4 -> 23.2 per round. Correct by the live rules, and it moves AWAY from live (2 rounds / 82%): the pessimistic bias is now about -32 points of party HP. THIS is the current regression baseline.

bias.direction: PESSIMISTIC — Mindscape consistently under-rates the party
bias.reason: This is the intended direction (spec Part 6): a fight Mindscape calls hard is genuinely hard. Do not 'fix' it by inflating party output.
knownCauses: summons not modelled — live fields 1-2 Fox fire phantasms on the party side that soak and deal damage
reaction layer not modelled — Prophetic Defender, damage reducers, and the conflict_start passives (Psychic Gifts, Beyond the Realms of Death, Heart of Darkness, Lucky Number) all fired live
Opportunities and Fabula Point invokes not modelled

howToRead: Treat a Mindscape verdict as roughly one round LONG and ~25-30 points LOW on party HP. A Mindscape result of '3 rounds at 53%' corresponds to a real fight of about 2 rounds at 80%.
